model_annotation: Figure 2 is a pie chart that illustrates the distribution of opinions regarding the readiness and qualifications of implementers for the execution of projects for the production of passive houses in Bulgaria. The chart is composed of four distinct sectors, each representing a different category of response. The largest sector, colored green, accounts for 51% of the total and is labeled "Само малка част от изпълнителите са подготвени да изпълняват проекти според стандарта Пасивна сграда, а голям брой специалисти имат нужда от обучения за изпълнението на стандарта" (Only a small number of implementers are prepared to carry out projects according to the Passive House standard, and a large number of specialists need training for the implementation of the standard). The second largest sector, colored purple, represents 23% and is labeled "Подготвени и добре квалифицирани са, за да изпълняват проекти според стандарта Пасивна сграда" (Prepared and well-qualified to carry out projects according to the Passive House standard). A second sector, colored red, also represents 23% and is labeled "Само част от изпълнителите (проектантите) са подготвени да изпълняват проекти според стандарта Пасивна сграда" (Only a part of the implementers (designers) are prepared to carry out projects according to the Passive House standard). The smallest sector, colored blue, accounts for 3% and is labeled "Няма Достатъчно подготвени и квалифицирани специалисти за изграждане на сгради според стандарта Пасивна къща" (There are not enough prepared and qualified specialists for the construction of buildings according to the Passive House standard). The chart includes a legend on the right side that corresponds to the colors of the sectors, and the percentages are displayed within the respective sectors. The green sector is visually the largest, followed by the purple and red sectors, which are equal in size, with the blue sector being the smallest.
